description_en: Queries the usage of tiered storage for media asset management
description_zh: 查询媒资管理分级存储的用量
kebab_example: aliyun vod describe-vod-tiering-storage-data --start-time 2023-05-29T01:00:00Z --end-time 2023-05-29T02:00:00Z --biz-region cn-beijing --storage-class IA --app-id app-1000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVodTieringStorageData

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. If this parameter is left empty, data of the last 24 hours is returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ。若为空，则默认读取最近24小时的数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. The time range cannot exceed 31 days. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据结束时间点，需晚于起始时间，不能相差超过31天。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The storage region. By default, data of all regions is returned. You can specify multiple regions separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 存储地域。默认返回所有地域。支持批量查询，多个区域用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The storage class. By default, data of all storage classes is returned. Valid values:
IA: Infrequent Access.
Archive: Archive.
ColdArchive: Cold Archive
parameters.help_zh:
存储类型，默认返回所有类型。取值：
IA：低频
Archive：归档
ColdArchive：冷归档
parameters.name: storage_class
